elements.title: Bayonet Trench (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a popular myth held that the French soldiers interred in Bayonet Trench (pictured) were buried alive with their rifles in their hands?

elements.title: Ratnākara (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a lost chronicle of the kings of Kashmir is attributed to the author Ratnākara?

elements.title: GNX (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a critic described GNX, after its surprise release, as Kendrick Lamar's "greatest work" yet?

elements.title: Nina Tikhonova (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that ballet dancer Nina Tikhonova taught dance to children who had been orphaned during World War II?

elements.title: Gifted (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that former adult actress Suzumi Suzuki's book Gifted was nominated for the Akutagawa Prize in 2022?

elements.title: George Bogaars (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that George Bogaars, as head of Singapore's Secret Branch, oversaw the detention of more than a hundred suspected communist sympathisers?

elements.title: a snowy NFL playoff game (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Green Bay Packers won a snowy NFL playoff game by scoring six straight touchdowns after they had been losing 14–0?

elements.title: William C. Roberts (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that William C. Roberts had to resign a pastorate in Ohio because his wife's illness was believed to be curable if she returned to her home state?

elements.title: anarchism without adjectives (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that anarchism without adjectives has been described as an ecumenical or non-denominational form of anarchism?
